translation:
In the fever of injury, if it is due to excessive loss of blood, and the pulse is large and surging yet empty, and on heavy pressure it is entirely absent, this is fever from blood deficiency; use Dang Gui Blood-Supplementing Decoction (當歸補血湯). If the pulse is deep and faint, and soft and weak on pressure, this is fever from exuberant yin; one should use Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯) with added parched ginger (炮薑) and aconite (附子). If there is fever, vexation, and agitation, with twitching of the flesh and trembling of the sinews, this is loss of blood (亡血); one should use Sage Healing Decoction (聖愈湯). If there is fever with sweating that does not stop, this is collapse of the blood (血脫); one should use Single Ginseng Decoction (獨參湯). In the condition of collapse of the blood, if the pulse is replete it is difficult to treat; if it is fine and small it is easy to treat. <ins>Dang Gui Blood-Supplementing Decoction (當歸補血湯)</ins>
Astragalus (黃耆, honey-fried, one liang), dang gui (當歸, three qian)
Decoct in water and take.
